name: personal-agentic-os-setup
description: Six-session guided build of a personal file-based agentic OS: scope one role, capture how you operate and how you write, harvest real material into folders, write first workflows, and install a weekly review loop.

interface.shortDescription: Build your own agentic OS, one interview at a time
interface.longDescription: A six-session guided build of a personal file-based agentic OS in your own folder: AGENTS.md routing, context files, a voice and refusal profile, workflows, and a weekly review loop. You answer questions; the agent creates and maintains the files.
defaultPrompt: Build my personal agentic OS. Interview me.
